author: mark
text:
docs: 'Everyone uses the front door' principle + §3.4 CLI as control plane

PRINCIPLES.md: add new bullet stating the lernie CLI is the sole
control plane for inter-procedure invocation. Disk-as-bus (§3.1)
carries state; the CLI carries commands; no third channel.

ARCHITECTURE.md §3.4: mechanical claim. Subagent dispatch is
`lernie dispatch …`. Subprocess exec vs in-process re-entry is an
implementation detail per procedure; the CLI interface is invariant.
No renumbering of existing §3.1–§3.3.

Sharpens 'Symmetry of dispatch' (fixes the invocation mechanism) and
extends 'Integrations are external binaries' inward.
